summary: Coming soon: the vq8sh14-q4k-mtpnative conversion of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, with its embedded native drafter.
note: SnowLLM integration is pending. The target uses VQ experts and Q4_K projections, not the existing V4-Flash-0731 quantization path. The 40 base files are byte-range parts that require assembly. This package also includes the matching 1017 Engram tables and vision sidecar; Engram, vision and native drafter support are not implemented for this model yet. Download size includes both Engram shards; allow extra disk space to assemble the base. No serving defaults or release date are promised.
